Barh men atikraman hatane ke dauran jamkar baval dekhne ko mila... atikraman ke virodh men pulis aur graminon ke bich hangama huaa... ghatna men kaee pulis karmiyon ko chot aaee
Begusray ke nayaganv thana kshetr men yuvak ka hathiyar lahrate ril banane ka vidiyo soshal midiya par vayral ho raha... yuvak ne bhojpuri gane par hath men hathiyar lahrate hue ril banaee
Bihar men uchch shiksha vibhag men jald banpar bahali niklegi... 13 hajar 208 padon par bahali ka vigyapan jald jari kiya jaega
